tokens.v: Crop to his jaw, ear and the near cup worn in place, eyes closed above the frame, chin dropped a degree as the first note lands. Camera level with the ear cup's centre and swung 15 degrees behind him so the outer disc reads nearly square-on and the brushed-copper headband arc runs out of the top-right corner: 100mm at f/2.8, the matte charcoal composite disc concentric with the pad ring around it, one continuous fine chamfer stepping between them, the copper hinge firing a single anisotropic streak rather than a mirror, the protein-leather pad compressing softly against his jaw with the skin giving where it bears. That pad and cup carry no mark, badge, port, lettering or status light of any kind — one clean unbroken surface. Skin keeps true pore texture through the falloff, the precise low side part holding its line above. His collarbone and a charcoal crew neckline fade through the bottom edge; nothing below the chest is anywhere in frame.
